title: The account shell is not runnable
fault: The injection sets the account shell to /bin/false.
prompts: Why does the server refuse a key it accepted before?
What does the method list name that the other refusals did not?
hints: The method list still names the password method, so the auth config did not change.
The daemon checks the account shell before it starts a session. Ask what your shell is now.

reveal.wrong: The injection set the shell of the practice account to /bin/false, and the shell is missing from /etc/shells, so the daemon refuses the account outright.
reveal.fix: Set a shell that the daemon accepts for the account with chsh or usermod, and log in again.
